post.description:
Names a Reel — `{ id }` of an existing one, or `{ create }` to create it in the same transaction — and every Label for it, each at an explicit position with all its Identifiers. Labels are identifiable by default (`indexing: default`), so a Collision surfaces at the station.

`key` is unique per Team: the same key with the same content returns the same Reel Pre-enrollment and Reel (200) — a lost response is simply asked again; the same key with different content is 409 `pre_enrollment_key_reused`. A submitted Reel Pre-enrollment never changes: retry a whole Reel under a new key, and positions that already landed come back `already_pre_enrolled`.

Validation failures are 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` with `detail.reason` one of `position_invalid`, `position_repeated`, `crop_not_staged` (with `detail.sha256`), `label_no_identifiers`, `too_many_labels`. Poll `GET /reel-pre-enrollments/{id}` for progress. Items run on apid's background worker, which runs only where the database change feed is enabled (`start --changes`, `DB_CHANGE_FEED_ENABLED=true`).
